_meta.definition: The process of managing awards, nominations, and recognitions for players based on their performance.

columns.name: playerID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the player entity

columns.name: yearid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

columns.name: votedBy
columns.description: Stores voter group (BBWAA) for baseball players inducted into the Hall of Fame.

columns.name: ballots
columns.description: Stores the number of ballots a player has received for Hall of Fame consideration.

columns.name: needed
columns.description: Stores the number of players inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame.

columns.name: votes
columns.description: Stores the total number of votes received by baseball players for Hall of Fame induction.

columns.name: inducted
columns.description: Stores a binary indicator (Y/N) for players inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Stores the category of each Hall of Fame member (Player).

columns.name: needed_note
columns.description: Stores notes regarding eligibility statuses of baseball players in various ballots.
